source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: Fellow Ode Gen 2 grind settings (cold brew 7–11)

procedure.en: Ships pre-calibrated. To recalibrate: set the dial to 11, remove the front plate and the dial, run the grinder, turn counter-clockwise one click at a time until the burrs touch, then one click clockwise and power off. The burrs are now at 1.
procedure.pt-BR: Sai de fábrica calibrado. Para recalibrar: coloque o dial em 11, retire a placa frontal e o dial, ligue o moedor, gire no sentido anti-horário um clique por vez até as mós se tocarem, depois um clique no sentido horário e desligue. As mós estão agora na posição 1.

notes: Fellow: 'Ode is not suitable for espresso'; Honest Coffee Guide's espresso row 1–2 is nominal. Values are a step index from 0: dial number = 1 + floor(index ÷ 3), sub-click = index mod 3, so 4.0 = 9, 5.2 = 14, 6.0 = 15, 11 = 30 (31 steps in total). Honest Coffee Guide writes x.1 and x.2 for the two clicks after number x; Seattle Coffee Gear numbers clicks 1–31 (their click 1 = index 0). Fellow's stated range starts at '250–300 microns and up'. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 29.5 µm per click ((1160 − 275) ÷ 30), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Calibration article: fellowproducts.com/blogs/learn/how-to-install-and-calibrate-ode-gen-2-brew-burrs-and-ssp-mp-burrs. Product page: fellowproducts.com/products/ode-brew-grinder-gen-2.
